# n8n_data_tables (Data Source)

Fetches a list of all n8n data tables



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data_tables` (Attributes List) List of data tables (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_tables))

<a id="nestedatt--data_tables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_tables`

Read-Only:

- `columns` (Attributes List) Column definitions for the data table (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_tables--columns))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the data table was created
- `id` (String) Data table identifier
- `name` (String) Data table name
- `project_id` (String) Project ID the data table belongs to
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the data table was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--data_tables--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_tables.columns`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Column identifier
- `index` (Number) Column position index
- `name` (String) Column name
- `type` (String) Column data type
